# Temu
> Temu is a global online marketplace for consumer goods, featuring shopping, order management, policies, and affiliate resources.

Temu provides e-commerce shopping across categories such as fashion, home, electronics, beauty, and toys, alongside customer support, legal policies, and partner programs. The links below prioritize help, policy, and program resources that are useful for structured site understanding.

## Help Center
- [Help Center Home](https://www.temu.com/support-center.html): Main customer support hub for orders, payments, shipping, returns, and account issues.
- [Track Your Order](https://www.temu.com/support-center/order-shipping.html): Help resources for order status, shipment tracking, and delivery questions.
- [Returns and Refunds](https://www.temu.com/support-center/returns-refunds.html): Guidance on return eligibility, refund processing, and related support topics.
- [Payment Issues](https://www.temu.com/support-center/payment-promotions.html): Support information for payment methods, charges, promotions, and checkout problems.
- [Account and Security](https://www.temu.com/support-center/account-security.html): Help for login, account settings, verification, and security concerns.
- [Product and Stock Questions](https://www.temu.com/support-center/products-stock.html): Answers about product availability, listings, and item-related concerns.

## Orders, Shipping, and Delivery
- [Order Support](https://www.temu.com/support-center/order-shipping.html): Central support page for order processing, shipment, and delivery issues.
- [Shipping Information](https://www.temu.com/support-center/shipping-delivery.html): Details on shipping timelines, delivery expectations, and logistics questions.
- [Track Package](https://www.temu.com/support-center/track-package.html): Resources for locating and monitoring package delivery progress.
- [Delayed or Missing Orders](https://www.temu.com/support-center/missing-package.html): Support for delayed shipments, lost packages, and non-delivery cases.
- [Order Cancellation](https://www.temu.com/support-center/cancel-order.html): Information on when and how orders can be canceled.
- [Delivery Problems](https://www.temu.com/support-center/delivery-issues.html): Help for incorrect addresses, failed delivery, and related shipping issues.

## Returns, Refunds, and Purchase Protection
- [Returns and Refunds](https://www.temu.com/support-center/returns-refunds.html): Overview of return processes, refund timing, and eligibility conditions.
- [How to Return an Item](https://www.temu.com/support-center/how-to-return.html): Step-by-step instructions for initiating and completing a return.
- [Refund Status](https://www.temu.com/support-center/refund-status.html): Information on checking refund progress and expected processing times.
- [Purchase Protection Program](https://www.temu.com/support-center/purchase-protection.html): Summary of protections available for eligible purchases and disputes.
- [Damaged or Incorrect Items](https://www.temu.com/support-center/item-issue.html): Support for defective, damaged, or wrong-item orders.
- [Return Shipping Questions](https://www.temu.com/support-center/return-shipping.html): Clarifies return labels, shipping costs, and return logistics.

## Account, Payments, and Promotions
- [Account and Security](https://www.temu.com/support-center/account-security.html): Help with account access, password resets, and security settings.
- [Payment and Promotions](https://www.temu.com/support-center/payment-promotions.html): Support for payment methods, billing issues, coupons, and discounts.
- [Manage Payment Methods](https://www.temu.com/support-center/payment-methods.html): Information on supported payment options and payment management.
- [Login Issues](https://www.temu.com/support-center/login-issues.html): Troubleshooting for sign-in failures and account access problems.
- [Coupons and Credits](https://www.temu.com/support-center/coupons-credits.html): Explains coupon usage, credits, and promotional balance questions.
- [Price Adjustment Help](https://www.temu.com/support-center/price-adjustment.html): Guidance on eligibility and process for price adjustment requests.

## Legal and Policy
- [Terms of Use](https://www.temu.com/terms-of-use.html): Governs use of the Temu website, services, and platform features.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.temu.com/privacy-and-cookie-policy.html): Describes collection, use, and sharing of personal information and cookies.
- [Cookie Policy](https://www.temu.com/privacy-and-cookie-policy.html): Explains cookie usage and related privacy controls on the platform.
- [Intellectual Property Policy](https://www.temu.com/intellectual-property-policy.html): Policy for trademarks, copyrights, and intellectual property complaints.
- [Accessibility Statement](https://www.temu.com/accessibility-statement.html): Information about accessibility efforts and support for users with disabilities.
- [California Privacy Notice](https://www.temu.com/california-privacy-policy.html): Additional privacy disclosures and rights for California residents.

## Compliance and Reporting
- [Report Suspicious Activity](https://www.temu.com/report-suspicious-activity.html): Channel for reporting scams, abuse, or suspicious conduct related to Temu.
- [Product Recall Information](https://www.temu.com/product-recalls.html): Notices and information regarding recalled or unsafe products.
- [Intellectual Property Reporting](https://www.temu.com/intellectual-property-policy.html): Instructions for submitting copyright or trademark infringement complaints.
- [Consumer Rights Requests](https://www.temu.com/privacy-and-cookie-policy.html): Privacy-related rights and request mechanisms described in policy materials.
- [Safety and Compliance Support](https://www.temu.com/support-center/product-safety.html): Help resources related to product safety and compliance concerns.

## Affiliate and Partner Programs
- [Affiliate Program](https://www.temu.com/affiliate.html): Overview of Temu’s affiliate program for creators and marketing partners.
- [Affiliate Terms](https://www.temu.com/affiliate-terms.html): Terms and conditions governing participation in the affiliate program.
- [Partner Support](https://www.temu.com/support-center/affiliate-program.html): Support resources for affiliate and promotional program questions.
- [Influencer Collaboration](https://www.temu.com/influencer-program.html): Information for creators interested in promotional partnerships with Temu.

- [Women’s Clothing](https://www.temu.com/womens-clothing-c-80.html): Category page for women’s apparel and related fashion products.
- [Men’s Clothing](https://www.temu.com/mens-clothing-c-81.html): Category page for men’s apparel and fashion items.
- [Home and Kitchen](https://www.temu.com/home-kitchen-c-98.html): Category page for household, kitchen, and home improvement products.
- [Beauty and Health](https://www.temu.com/beauty-health-c-86.html): Category page for cosmetics, personal care, and wellness items.
- [Electronics](https://www.temu.com/electronics-c-83.html): Category page for gadgets, accessories, and consumer electronics.
- [Toys and Games](https://www.temu.com/toys-games-c-94.html): Category page for toys, games, and children’s products.
